context: A teen tells her aunt about a confusing crush
purpose: Teach: 告白/なぜか/何だか/あう/いまだに/貰っ/現に/伴っ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ねえ叔母さん、ちょっと聞いてほしいんだけど…昨日、クラスの男子に告白されちゃって。
lines.en: Hey auntie, can I tell you something? A boy in my class confessed to me yesterday.
lines.style: Hesitant teen opening up shyly to trusted aunt

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: あら、それはおめでとう。で、なぜかあなたの顔は微妙な表情をしてるわね。
lines.en: Oh, congrats! But somehow your face looks a bit conflicted.
lines.style: Warm aunt teasing gently with perceptive observation

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うん…何だか自分の気持ちがよく分からなくて。彼とは話すと気があうし、嫌いじゃないんだけど。
lines.en: Yeah... somehow I don't really get my own feelings. We click when we talk, and I don't dislike him.
lines.style: Confused teen voicing tangled emotions slowly aloud

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 返事はもうしたの?それとも、いまだに保留のまま?
lines.en: Did you give him an answer yet, or is it still on hold?
lines.style: Aunt asking practical follow-up question kindly

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 保留。手紙も貰ってしまって、机にしまってあるの。現に今もカバンに入ってる。
lines.en: On hold. I even received a letter from him, and it's tucked in my desk. Actually it's in my bag right now.
lines.style: Teen confessing concrete evidence with nervous laugh

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: なるほどね。恋愛って楽しさと不安が伴ってくるものだから、焦らなくていいのよ。
lines.en: I see. Romance comes with both joy and anxiety, so there's no need to rush.
lines.style: Aunt offering measured reassurance from life experience

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとう。ちょっと気持ちが楽になった。もう少し自分で考えてみる。
lines.en: Thanks. I feel a bit lighter now. I'll think it over by myself a little more.
lines.style: Relieved teen closing with quiet determination forming
